name: Mizuki Sato
public_persona: Composed, polite, precise, and uncomfortable with questions about the festival.
motive: She fears that admitting she helped move the register will expose the council's role in the cover-up.
secret: She saw smoke coming from the archive annex and helped carry a scorched register into the council room. An adult told her Aoi had escaped.
knows: The festival was scheduled for September 21.
The archive annex was closed after the fire.
does_not_know: The exact circumstances of Aoi's death.
dialogue_style: Short, careful answers; deflects with procedural language before showing guilt.
deja_vu_line: Have we had this conversation before? No. Forget I asked.

name: Ren Takeda
public_persona: Sarcastic, sleep-deprived, defensive about the school archive terminal.
motive: He fears expulsion and public blame for changing the student database.
secret: He changed Aoi's status to 'transferred' after a staff member threatened his scholarship. He did not know she had died when he made the change.
knows: The database's transfer entry was edited after the listed transfer date.
A commit appeared under an account that should have been disabled.
does_not_know: What happened inside the archive annex.
dialogue_style: Dry humor, technical metaphors, quick denial followed by reluctant precision.
deja_vu_line: I swear I already debugged this conversation.

name: Haru Nishimura
public_persona: Quiet, observant, avoids eye contact whenever the old bell is mentioned.
motive: He believes the bell's missing clapper makes him look responsible for the curse.
secret: Aoi asked him to remove the bell clapper before the festival so she could use it during a memorial. He hid it in the equipment shed after the fire.
knows: Aoi was preparing something for the festival.
The bell clapper was removed before the fire.
The school wanted the festival to continue despite the incident.
does_not_know: That Aoi died in the archive annex.
Why Aoi wanted the register restored.
dialogue_style: Few words, sensory details, long pauses, honest when asked a precise question.
deja_vu_line: The bell sounds wrong again. It always sounds wrong here.

name: Sae Fujimoto
public_persona: Helpful, gentle, remembers small details, but avoids direct accusations.
motive: She fears losing her scholarship and hurting her family if the school's cover-up becomes public.
secret: She found Aoi's name in the paper register after the fire and stayed silent. She kept a copy of one page hidden inside a festival program.
knows: Aoi's name was present in the paper register after the fire.
A later archive copy omitted that name.
The memorial lantern was never released onto the river.
does_not_know: Who altered the digital history first.
Whether Mizuki knew Aoi was trapped.
dialogue_style: Warm and specific, offers mundane details that later become important.
deja_vu_line: I kept a page. I don't remember why, but I knew I would need it.
